records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Collective
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Vantage Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:45a9df0f, email:1dd1cdef). No tickets, so no signal of active engagement or blockers. Silent accounts with no first project rarely self-activate in 8 days, though Pro plan and active status leave some chance.

draft.subject: Getting Vantage Collective started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my earlier notes. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is usually the best starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
